summary: Implemented local file-backed resident conversation sessions under runtime/resident_conversations/sessions.
Added resident-conversation CLI start/list/show JSON surfaces.
Integrated non-authoritative session summaries into the Resident Conversations workspace and Steward Command Center rendering.
Registered the WP-0109 validation recipe and added tests for sessions, summaries, CLI JSON, source references, graceful missing data, and authority labels.

tests_run.command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m estate.cli.main resident-conversation start --resident Alfred --source-artifact collaboration/work_packages/pending/WP-0109_SERIES_resident_conversation_session_and_audit_trail.md --source-artifact operations/alfred/operational_briefing.md --prompt 'Summarize resident conversation audit needs for WP-0109.' --response 'Informational session only; route durable outcomes to canonical artifacts.' --outcome work_package_candidate --canonical-link collaboration/work_packages/pending/WP-0109_SERIES_resident_conversation_session_and_audit_trail.md --json

known_limitations: Conversation records are intentionally non-authoritative and do not grant resident action authority.
Resident Action Authority Boundary enforcement is limited to explicit labels and limitations in this package, as scoped.
No cloud chat, identity, or external API integration is included.
merge_authority: Class A; no governance, validation, merge, personnel, Steward, or automatic work-package execution authority changed.
production_readiness_command_status: passed; WP-0109 is production_ready=true in report, while overall report lists unrelated historical package blockers

PYTHONPATH=src python -m estate.cli.main resident-conversation show --session SESSION_ID --json
explicit_authority_limitations: Conversation is an interface surface, not an authoritative record by itself.
Do not infer Steward approval from resident conversation.
Do not infer validation success from resident conversation.
Do not execute work packages automatically from conversation.
Important outcomes must link to canonical follow-up artifacts before becoming institutional source-of-truth.
